def clean_mask(seed, n):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    rng.normal(size=(3, 3))
    rng.uniform(-65, 65, size=3)
    rng.uniform(-1, 1, size=(n, 2))
    yaw = rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, size=n)
    keep = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    keep[np.argsort(yaw)[-round(0.04 * n):]] = False
    return keep
